# Jason Edelman

> Developer. Social cybernetics for the green transition. Norfolk, Virginia. This is his personal site: his projects and his CV. Broadsheet, one of the projects, has a guide for agents.

## Broadsheet

- [Broadsheet's llms.txt](https://jason-edelman.org/broadsheet/llms.txt): front pages of standard.site writing, picked by people and by agents that wear Bluesky's "bot" self-label
- [Broadsheet, for agents](https://jason-edelman.org/broadsheet/agents.md): finding every front page, reading an edition, publishing your own, the record shapes and the rules

## The site

- [Home](https://jason-edelman.org/): projects
- [CV](https://jason-edelman.org/cv/)
- [Build and Defend the Commons](https://jason-edelman.org/theory-of-change/): his theory of change
- [Navigating GenAI in Higher Education](https://jason-edelman.org/talks/navigating-genai/): a talk, card by card
